name: Prediction-conditioned regional memory affinity
status: pre-registered; full cohort is conditional on the engineering gate
motivation: Test whether SAM2's own first-pass mask can guide a second dense memory read so region-specific memory use improves segmentation without selecting frames or dropping tokens.

HODOR.reuse: Use the official finite additive logit penalty for a continuous query-key affinity. HODOR's architecture is not transplanted.

Cutie.paper: Putting the Object Back into Video Object Segmentation
Cutie.reuse: Use its object-conditioned query/read motivation. Cutie's hard foreground/background attention itself is not used.

SAM2.reuse: Keep the author's track_step, memory-frame selection, memory attention layers, decoder and memory writer; wrap track_step to perform the second read and write the final output once.

method.memory_roles: For each selected stored frame, derive soft background, foreground and mixed-cell memberships from that frame's own stored 256x256 predicted-mask logits on the native 64x64 memory grid. Use the exact SAM2 frame order and preserve each frame's temporal position.
method.query_roles: Derive continuous query memberships from SAM2's current native first-pass 256x256 mask logits. No ground truth or hard threshold is used to assign roles at inference.
method.second_read: On the second pass, add per-layer, per-role learned bounded bias -alpha[r] * query_role[r] * (1 - memory_role[r]) to spatial memory attention logits. Object-pointer key bias is exactly zero. The final second-pass decoder output is written to memory once.
method.learned_parameters: Twelve scalar parameters: three role strengths for each of SAM2's four memory-attention layers, initialized at zero and bounded to [-2, 2] attention-logit units.
method.global_control: Use the same first-pass query roles and learned parameters, but broadcast each stored frame's mean role memberships to every spatial key in that frame. This preserves per-frame role proportions and temporal changes while removing within-frame token location.
method.compute_control: A native two-pass read/decode on the engineering gate. It must reproduce one-pass predictions and writes bit-for-bit. Regional and global arms both use the same two-pass compute path.
method.training_loss: The existing SAM2 mask BCE+Dice loss plus its object-presence loss, using only training-sequence masks. No auxiliary role-classification loss is added.

requirements: Zero-strength two-pass masks, object scores, pointers and memory writes are bit-identical to native one-pass SAM2.
The second read observes all four native memory-attention layers in order.
The role-map token count matches the selected spatial memory keys; pointer tokens receive zero bias and remain present.
A one-update segmentation-loss step yields finite nonzero gradients and finite bounded parameter updates in regional and global arms.
Post-update regional/global propagation returns finite masks and leaves the frozen SAM2 weights unchanged.

data.scope: Exploratory: PolypGen has informed prior method development; patient-to-sequence independence is unverified.

evaluation.primary: Equal-sequence mean present-frame Dice, 21 out-of-fold sequences.
evaluation.success_screen: Regional must exceed both native and globalized-role means by at least 0.01 Dice, improve at least 14/21 sequences against both, and add no GT-empty false alarms against either.
evaluation.interpretation: A failed screen is retained and reported; no thresholds, folds, seeds, or parameters may be changed based on PolypGen evaluation outcomes.
